verdict.rationale: A developer SDK could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec or schema, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no OpenAPI or equivalent downloadable spec for the SDK. llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes, not API specs, and structured outputs are a runtime feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
